scope_outcomes.criterion: A passage must name Weber or identify a Weber work or idea as a cited object; direct work-level citations are distinguished from secondary reports or mentions without a work.
scope_outcomes.basis: The main text names Weber in a report of Emigh et al.’s theoretical combination with Gramsci, but gives no specific Weber work or locus. The references were inspected for a standalone Weber entry.
limitations: The finding is a named-thinker mention reported through a secondary source, not a direct citation of a specific Weber work.
This assessment concerns the supplied source and held passage window, not the author’s complete work or Weber’s entire reception.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
